subject.title: perf: use a focused OpenClaw prepack profile for diagnostics

question: Should diagnostic runs use a reduced OpenClaw package artifact, and which release contents may be omitted without weakening Kova's release-shaped validation guarantee?
rationale: Repository policy establishes the fidelity constraint, but neither the issue nor the supplied discussion defines acceptable omissions or which repository should own the profile contract.

options.title: Specify and benchmark the profile
options.body: Define permitted omissions and fidelity checks, then implement the profile only if measured packaging savings are material.

options.title: Retain generic packaging
options.body: Keep diagnostics on the existing release-shaped package path so diagnostic and release runs continue validating the same artifact shape.

options.title: Optimize packaging upstream
options.body: Reduce the cost of the generic release package instead of introducing a diagnostics-specific artifact contract.

recommendation.title: Specify and benchmark the profile
recommendation.body: Define permitted omissions and fidelity checks, then implement the profile only if measured packaging savings are material.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the issue and have the strongest recent history in Kova performance and reporting work.
